findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "resource-markets-get-prices" is 7057 chars, far longer than this server's median (1119). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-blog-post, list-blog-posts, pages-get, pages-list, pages-search, search-blog-posts · Private data: resource-markets-get-activity · Public sink: resource-markets-get-activity, resource-markets-get-prices, get-blog-post, list-blog-posts, search-blog-posts · Destructive: resource-markets-get-prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-blog-post, list-blog-posts, pages-get, pages-list, pages-search, search-blog-posts · Private data: resource-markets-get-activity · Public sink: resource-markets-get-activity, resource-markets-get-prices, get-blog-post, list-blog-posts, search-blog-posts · Destructive: resource-markets-get-prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
